messages:
Nina (CS): Heads up 10-day renewal for HeliosOps. Procurement sent PO-99214 but its missing billing_contact and wants Net45, a VAT clause, and a temporary seat reduction (2 seats for months 3-6). Need to align on billing and amendment approach.
Carlos (AE): Thanks. Can we accept Net45 without a price change? Also confirm how they want the seat change reflected (prorate vs credit).
Sam (Billing): We can accept Net45 if we get a signed PO before invoicing. Billing needs vendor_code and billing_contact in the PO. For proration we need exact effective dates.
procurement-bot: PO uploaded: PO-99214 (pending validation) :paperclip:
Nina (CS): Procurement suggests vendor_code = "HELIOSOPS-UK" and billing_contact = finance@heliosops.co.uk. They explicitly prefer proration not credit.
Priya (Legal): Ill draft a one-paragraph amendment to the MSA: change payment terms to Net45, add vendor_code update, include the VAT clause language, and reference the DPA. No other contract language will change. ETA EOD today.
Carlos (AE): Commercial proposal: keep list price, honor Net45, apply proration for the 2-seat reduction (months 3-6), and add a $500 one-time onboarding credit to offset cash flow. If procurement pushes back on the credit we can waive.
Onboarding (Ops): Heads up: if seats drop mid-onboarding well need to adjust session invites and materials. Risk: delayed enablement for remaining users. I can rework schedule once Nina confirms final seat counts and dates.
Sam (Billing): Example proration lines for our invoicing system: ```
Invoice lines:
 - 10 seats x $550/mo = $5,500
 - Prorate (2 seats) 2026-06-15 to 2026-09-15 = -$1,100
Subtotal: $4,400
```
Nina (CS): Action list:
 - Carlos: get revised PO with billing_contact and vendor_code (asked to resend)
 - Priya: draft amendment and route for e-sign once PO is in
 - Sam: hold billing until signed amendment and PO received; prepare proration template
 - Onboarding: standby to update schedule once final seat plan confirmed
procurement-bot: PO-99214 validation failed  missing billing_contact field. Please upload corrected PO.
Carlos (AE): I asked the customer to update the PO with billing_contact=finance@heliosops.co.uk and the vendor_code string. Theyre sending a new PO within the hour.
Nina (CS): Great. Once we have the PO and Priyas amendment well route DocuSign same day. Marking follow-up for 3pm PT tomorrow if not signed. :calendar:
Carlos (AE): If they sign today we can invoice on the first billing cycle with Net45 terms applied. Ill confirm with them about the onboarding credit.
Sam (Billing): Reminder: accounting wants executed amendment and signed PO emailed to accounting@redwood.com before processing.
Priya (Legal): Draft ready, uploading to legal drive and will send for e-sign after PO lands.
Nina (CS): Thanks team. Ill update thread when PO arrives or if onboarding schedule needs changes. :thumbsup:
